mieruka now covers five agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Antigravity.

New in this release:

- Cursor: the four rule types in `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` (always, by file pattern, when the agent finds them relevant, manual), plus `AGENTS.md` in the root and in subfolders. A rule saved as `.md` is ignored by Cursor, and mieruka now says so.
- GitHub Copilot, as it works on GitHub.com: `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, path-specific `.instructions.md` files with their `applyTo` patterns, the nearest `AGENTS.md`, and `CLAUDE.md` or `GEMINI.md` in the repository root. Git-ignored files are shown as not read, since they never reach GitHub.
- Antigravity, which replaced Gemini CLI and still reads `GEMINI.md`: global and project rules, the four triggers, and checks for rules dropped for lack of a `trigger`, files cut at 24,000 bytes and the 20,000-token budget.
- The agent panel has a menu with each agent's token total instead of a row of buttons.
- Cmd+Z (Ctrl+Z on Windows and Linux) undoes reverts one at a time, as many as you made. Undo refuses when the file changed after the revert, so later edits are never overwritten. Before, a single undo could replace them.
- Other vendors' own files no longer clutter the list as "not read"; that label is kept for `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md`, where people expect it.

## Download

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x64 | `mieruka-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` |
| macOS, Apple Silicon | `mieruka-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |
| macOS, Intel | `mieruka-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |
| Linux x64 | `mieruka-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz` |

Each archive holds one binary and the license. `SHA256SUMS` lists the checksums.

The binaries are not signed yet. On macOS, run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine mieruka` once after unpacking; on Windows, SmartScreen may ask you to confirm the first start.

Token counts are estimates. If what mieruka shows differs from what your agent actually loads, please open an issue.
